IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Thursday 26 November
Winds: Southerly 10 to 15 knots tending southeasterly in the evening then becoming variable below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Clear.

Friday 27 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then shifting north to northwesterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny day. 60% chance of showers in the evening.

Saturday 28 November
Winds: Northeasterly 10 to 15 knots shifting southwesterly 15 to 20 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre, decreasing below 0.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to around 1 metre around midday.
Weather: Cloudy. Near 100% chance of rain.

Sunday 29 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Monday 30 November
Winds: Westerly 15 to 25 knots decreasing to about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high to the east of the state is expected to slowly move away, across the Tasman Sea, until the end of the week while maintaining a weak ridge over Tasmania. A trough over Victoria will extend over northwestern waters on Friday then move over Tasmania on Saturday morning, before moving away to the east. A cold front arrives during the day Sunday.

IDT12326.text:

Sunday 29 November
Winds: Southwesterly 20 to 30 knots turning westerly during the morning.
Seas: 2 to 3 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 4 metres offshore.
Swell: Northeasterly 1.5 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning.
